"""Capture blake2s compress inputs/outputs by single-stepping one function.

Usage: python dbgtrace3.py <dir> <tag> <stdin_text>
Writes <dir>/<tag>.comp.jsonl with {state_in, block, t, last, state_out, ret}
"""
import sys, ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"<G5A_WORKDIR>").resolve()

def safe(p) -> Path:
    rp = Path(p).resolve()
    if rp != ROOT and ROOT not in rp.parents:
        raise ValueError("outside ROOT")
    return rp

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
ntdll = ctypes.WinDLL('ntdll')

class STARTUPINFOW(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('cb', wt.DWORD), ('lpReserved', wt.LPWSTR), ('lpDesktop', wt.LPWSTR),
                ('lpTitle', wt.LPWSTR), ('dwX', wt.DWORD), ('dwY', wt.DWORD), ('dwXSize', wt.DWORD),
                ('dwYSize', wt.DWORD), ('dwXCountChars', wt.DWORD), ('dwYCountChars', wt.DWORD),
                ('dwFillAttribute', wt.DWORD), ('dwFlags', wt.DWORD), ('wShowWindow', wt.WORD),
                ('cbReserved2', wt.WORD), ('lpReserved2', ctypes.c_void_p), ('hStdInput', wt.HANDLE),
                ('hStdOutput', wt.HANDLE), ('hStdError', wt.HANDLE)]
class PROCESS_INFORMATION(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('hProcess', wt.HANDLE), ('hThread', wt.HANDLE), ('dwProcessId', wt.DWORD), ('dwThreadId', wt.DWORD)]
class EXCEPTION_RECORD64(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('ExceptionCode', wt.DWORD), ('ExceptionFlags', wt.DWORD), ('ExceptionRecord', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('ExceptionAddress', ctypes.c_uint64), ('NumberParameters', wt.DWORD),
                ('ExceptionInformation', ctypes.c_uint64 * 15)]
class EXP(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('ExceptionRecord', EXCEPTION_RECORD64), ('dwFirstChance', wt.DWORD)]
class CREATE_PROCESS_DEBUG_INFO(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('hFile', wt.HANDLE), ('hProcess', wt.HANDLE), ('hThread', wt.HANDLE),
                ('lpBaseOfImage', ctypes.c_void_p), ('DebugInfoFileOffset', wt.DWORD),
                ('nDebugInfoSize', wt.DWORD), ('lpThreadLocalBase', ctypes.c_void_p),
                ('lpStartAddress', ctypes.c_void_p), ('lpImageName', ctypes.c_void_p), ('fUnicode', wt.WORD)]
class CREATE_THREAD_DEBUG_INFO(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('hThread', wt.HANDLE), ('lpThreadLocalBase', ctypes.c_void_p), ('lpStartAddress', ctypes.c_void_p)]
class DEBUG_EVENT_U(ctypes.Union):
    _fields_ = [('Exception', EXP), ('CreateProcess', CREATE_PROCESS_DEBUG_INFO),
                ('CreateThread', CREATE_THREAD_DEBUG_INFO), ('raw', ctypes.c_byte * 152)]
class DEBUG_EVENT(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwDebugEventCode', wt.DWORD), ('dwProcessId', wt.DWORD), ('dwThreadId', wt.DWORD),
                ('pad4', wt.DWORD), ('u', DEBUG_EVENT_U), ('pad2', ctypes.c_byte * 32)]
class CONTEXT(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('P1Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P2Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P3Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P4Home', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('P5Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P6Home', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('ContextFlags', wt.DWORD), ('MxCsr', wt.DWORD),
                ('SegCs', wt.WORD), ('SegDs', wt.WORD), ('SegEs', wt.WORD), ('SegFs', wt.WORD),
                ('SegGs', wt.WORD), ('SegSs', wt.WORD), ('EFlags', wt.DWORD),
                ('Dr0', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr1', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr2', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr3', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Dr6', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr7', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rax', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rcx', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rdx', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rbx', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rsp', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rbp', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rsi', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rdi', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('R8', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R9', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R10', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R11', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('R12', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R13', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R14', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R15', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rip', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('FltSave', ctypes.c_byte * 512), ('VectorRegister', ctypes.c_byte * 26*16),
                ('DebugControl', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastBranchToRip', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastBranchFromRip', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('LastExceptionToRip', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastExceptionFromRip', ctypes.c_uint64)]

DEBUG_ONLY_THIS_PROCESS = 0x2
DBG_CONTINUE = 0x00010002
DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED = 0x80010001
EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT = 0x80000003
EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP = 0x80000004
CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS = 0x100010
CONTEXT_FULL = 0x100007

COMPRESS_RVA = 0x1d2a0
MAX_STEPS = 200000

_ctxbuf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1400)

def new_ctx(flags):
    addr = (ctypes.addressof(_ctxbuf) + 15) & ~15
    ctx = ctypes.cast(addr, ctypes.POINTER(CONTEXT)).contents
    ctx.ContextFlags = flags
    return ctx

def read_mem(hp, addr, size):
    if size <= 0 or size > (1 << 22):
        return None
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    got = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
    if k32.ReadProcessMemory(hp, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), buf, size, ctypes.byref(got)):
        return buf.raw[:got.value]
    return None

def main():
    wdir = safe(sys.argv[1])
    tag = sys.argv[2]
    stdin_text = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'hello\n'
    fin = wdir / (tag + '.stdin')
    fin.write_bytes(stdin_text.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1'))
    k32.CreateFileW.restype = wt.HANDLE
    hstdin = k32.CreateFileW(str(fin), 0x80000000, 1, None, 3, 0, None)
    si = STARTUPINFOW(); si.cb = ctypes.sizeof(si)
    si.dwFlags = 0x100
    si.hStdInput = hstdin
    pi = PROCESS_INFORMATION()
    exe = str(wdir / 'app.exe')
    r = k32.CreateProcessW(exe, None, None, None, True, DEBUG_ONLY_THIS_PROCESS,
                           None, str(wdir), ctypes.byref(si), ctypes.byref(pi))
    if not r:
        print('CreateProcess failed', ctypes.get_last_error()); return
    hp, pid = pi.hProcess, pi.dwProcessId
    print('pid', pid)
    logfile = (wdir / (tag + '.comp.jsonl')).open('w', encoding='utf-8')
    base = None
    tracing = False   # currently single-stepping through compress
    steps = 0
    cur = None
    trap_next_ret = False
    while True:
        ev = DEBUG_EVENT()
        if not k32.WaitForDebugEvent(ctypes.byref(ev), 60000):
            print('wait timeout'); break
        code = ev.dwDebugEventCode
        status = DBG_CONTINUE
        if code == 3 and base is None:
            base = ctypes.cast(ev.u.CreateProcess.lpBaseOfImage, ctypes.c_void_p).value or 0
            print('base', hex(base))
            # set DR0 = compress
            th = pi.hThread
            ctx = new_ctx(CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS)
            k32.GetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            ctx.Dr0 = base + COMPRESS_RVA
            ctx.Dr7 = 0x1
            ctx.Dr6 = 0
            k32.SetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            print('DR0 set')
        elif code == 2:
            th = ev.u.CreateThread.hThread
            ctx = new_ctx(CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS)
            k32.GetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            ctx.Dr0 = base + COMPRESS_RVA
            ctx.Dr7 = 0x1
            ctx.Dr6 = 0
            k32.SetThreadContext(th, ctx)
        elif code == 1:
            exc = ev.u.Exception.ExceptionRecord.ExceptionCode
            if exc in (EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP, EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT):
                status = DBG_CONTINUE
            else:
                status = DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
            th = k32.OpenThread(0x1FFFFF, False, ev.dwThreadId)
            ctx = new_ctx(CONTEXT_FULL)
            k32.GetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            if exc in (EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP, EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT) and not tracing and ctx.Rip == base + COMPRESS_RVA:
                # compress entry
                state_in = read_mem(hp, ctx.Rcx, 32)
                block = read_mem(hp, ctx.Rdx, 64)
                cur = {'t': ctx.R8, 'last': ctx.R9 & 0xff, 'state_in': state_in.hex() if state_in else None,
                       'block': block.hex() if block else None, 'ret': None}
                retb = read_mem(hp, ctx.Rsp, 8)
                cur['retaddr'] = int.from_bytes(retb, 'little') if retb else 0
                tracing = True
                steps = 0
                ctx.EFlags |= 0x100
                k32.SetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            elif tracing and exc == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP:
                steps += 1
                if steps > MAX_STEPS:
                    print('step cap')
                    tracing = False
                elif ctx.Rip == cur.get('retaddr'):
                    state_out = read_mem(hp, cur_state_addr[0], 32) if cur_state_addr[0] else None
                    cur['state_out'] = state_out.hex() if state_out else None
                    logfile.write(json.dumps(cur) + '\n')
                    logfile.flush()
                    print('captured compress: t=%d last=%d' % (cur['t'], cur['last']))
                    tracing = False
                else:
                    ctx.EFlags |= 0x100
                    k32.SetThreadContext(th, ctx)
            k32.CloseHandle(th)
        elif code == 5:
            print('EXIT', ev.u.Exception.ExceptionRecord.ExceptionCode)
            k32.ContinueDebugEvent(ev.dwProcessId, ev.dwThreadId, DBG_CONTINUE)
            break
        k32.ContinueDebugEvent(ev.dwProcessId, ev.dwThreadId, status)
    logfile.close()

cur_state_addr = [None]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
